description: Create a Rapyd hosted checkout page. Returns a redirect_url the payer opens in a browser. Rapyd renders the appropriate local methods (cards, cash pickup, bank transfer, wallets) for the country + currency combination, so one call supports 100+ countries.

amount.description: Amount in major units of the currency (e.g. 100 = 100 USD)

cancel_checkout_url.description: URL Rapyd redirects the payer to if they cancel

complete_checkout_url.description: URL Rapyd redirects the payer to after a successful payment

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code of the buyer (US, MX, BR, IN, NG, etc)

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code (USD, EUR, MXN, BRL, INR, NGN, etc)

customer.description: Rapyd customer id (cus_xxx). Optional — omit to let Rapyd create a one-off customer.

description.description: Human-readable description shown on the page

language.description: ISO-639 language code for the hosted page (en, es, pt, ...)

payment_method_type.description: Optional: restrict to a single method type (e.g. 'mx_oxxo_cash'). Omit for Rapyd to show all eligible methods.

payment_method_types_exclude.description: Blacklist of method types to hide

payment_method_types_include.description: Whitelist of method types to show

name: create_checkout_page
